short_description: ATLAS9 Kurucz ODFNEW/NOVER fluxes (SVO Kurucz; Castelli, Gratton & Kurucz 1997)
description: SVO's "Kurucz ODFNEW /NOVER models" grid (SVO model Kurucz): ATLAS9 fluxes with l/Hp = 1.25 and microturbulence 2 km/s, Teff 3,500-50,000 K, log g 0-5, [M/H] -2.5 to +0.5, from 90.9 Angstrom. SVO's registry record gives Castelli, Gratton & Kurucz (1997, A&A 318, 841) as its reference. It is a different set of spectra from Kurucz2003all (Castelli & Kurucz 2003): no spectrum's data is shared between the two.
